kind.description: dtype or str or tuple of dtypes/strs. dtype or dtype kind. Allowed dtype kinds are: * ``'bool'`` : boolean kind * ``'signed integer'`` : signed integer data types * ``'unsigned integer'`` : unsigned integer data types * ``'integral'`` : integer data types * ``'real floating'`` : real-valued floating-point data types * ``'complex floating'`` : complex floating-point data types * ``'numeric'`` : numeric data types
constraints: dtype and kind must be provided
